    static final IuJsonSerializationOptions
    IuJsonSerializationOptions.DEFAULT
    Options with all default values: Java property names as-is, with null properties omitted.
    static final IuJsonSerializationOptions
    IuJsonSerializationOptions.ENUM_AS_OBJECT
    Options with all other values default, with an enum value converted to a JsonObject describing the constant.
    static final IuJsonSerializationOptions
    IuJsonSerializationOptions.INCLUDE_NULLS
    Options with the default property name format, with every readable property present.
    static final IuJsonSerializationOptions
    IuJsonSerializationOptions.LEGACY
    Options with all other values default, restoring every conversion that changed in 7.1 to its earlier behavior: byte[] as base64 text, enum text by Enum.toString(), an empty Optional written as null, legacy property discovery, and legacy date formats.
